verses.text: For the music director. To be played on stringed instruments. A thoughtful psalm of David. God, listen to my prayer. Do not ignore my cry for mercy.
Listen to me and answer me. My troubles make me restless and I groan
because of what my enemy says and how the wicked attack me. They bring trouble on me and hate me in their anger.
My heart is in deep pain. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
Fear and trembling have come over me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
I said, "I wish I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away and be at rest.
I would fly far away and stay in the wilderness. Selah.
I would hurry to find shelter from the raging wind and storm."
Lord, confuse the wicked and mix up their words, because I see violence and fighting in the city.
Day and night they go around on its walls. Evil and trouble are inside it.
Destruction is inside the city. Threats and lies never leave its streets.
If an enemy were insulting me, I could put up with it. If someone who hated me were rising against me, I could hide from him.
But it is you, someone like me, my companion and close friend.
We used to share sweet friendship together. We walked together with the crowd at God's house.
Let death take my enemies by surprise. Let them go down alive into the grave, because evil lives in their homes and hearts.
But I call to God, and the LORD saves me.
Evening, morning, and noon I cry out in distress, and he hears my voice.
He rescues me unharmed from the battle against me, even though many people are against me.
God, who has ruled forever, will hear and bring them down. Selah. They never change their ways, and they do not respect God.
My friend attacks his friends. He breaks his promises.
His words are as smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, but they are like swords ready to strike.
Give your worries to the LORD, and he will take care of you. He will never let good people fall.
But you, God, will bring the wicked down into the pit of ruin. Murderers and liars will not live out half their lives. But I will trust in you.
